'''Galuf Cardaan''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mining/Legends|miner]] who lived on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Some folk took possession of a base and the owners want it back. The new owners don't seem willing to let them take it back.|Sergeant Snopel, to a commando|<ref name="SWG:CtT" />}}
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Galuf Cardaan was part of a group of mining professionals operating in the [[Gallo Mountains/Legends|Gallo Mountains]] of Naboo.<ref name="SWG:CtT" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> a group of criminals, the [[Mountain Poachers]], took over the [[Mountain poacher bunker|bunker]] that served as base of operations for the miners. Cardaan then contacted [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Snopel]],<ref name="SWG:CtT" /> a retired [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Commando/Legends|commando]],<ref name="SWG:C">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Commando|Commando|Tansarii Point Station}}</ref> in order to got rid of the [[Hunting/Legends|poachers]]. Snopel therefore dispatched a group of commandos under training to deal with the criminals. The commandos attacked the bunker, killing some poachers in the assault, and successfully reclaimed the building. The miners were very satisfied to be able to move back to their bunker.<ref name="SWG:CtT" />

==Behind the scenes==
Galuf Cardaan was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:CtT" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Galuf Cardaan was added to the game upon the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
